entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac, my ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought recently. I need to set up a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your order number to start?
Thank you. I see the order right here. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference issue. Honestly, I just find the whole interface to be very confusing. I really expected more from it. I've been through the user manual, but some of the features are just hard to use.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear it wasn't a good fit for you. Let me just check the return eligibility for your order. One moment please.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I see here that the VeloBand was delivered on December 22nd, which was 12 days ago.
That sounds right. Now, I know I'm outside of a typical 10-day window, but I was hoping we could come to an agreement. Perhaps a partial credit or a discount on a future purchase for my trouble?
That won't be necessary at all. Our policy actually allows for returns up to 90 days from the delivery date. You are well within that timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, ninety days? I must have misread the policy. Well, that's fantastic news. I was all prepared to negotiate. In that case, yes, please process the return.

Of course. I have just initiated the return authorization. You will receive an email within the next 15 minutes containing a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue the full refund back to your original payment method.
That's perfect. Thank you for making that so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Isaac.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
